scope: Frames come from the authored lattice in data/frames.json. The AXIS view generalises each claim's under_assumption UP to its axes, which is the safe direction - a claim held under social democracy is held under left economics, never the converse. A claim under several axes contributes one claim per axis, so the axis view has more claims than the position view by construction and proposition counts are not comparable across views; corroboration and conflict counts are.
